sam.w: Starting scheduled private rollout for tenant Zephyr tonight 2026-03-28 02:00 UTC. Plan = canary (slice A, 10%) -> ramp 50% -> full. Pin runtime to `redwood/serve:v2.3.1-rc3` for the window. Need: safety-pin on model variant + runtime, standby rollback target `redwood/serve:v2.2.9`, KMS access check, and a clear rollback trigger. @oncall @lucy please ack by EOD.

lucy: acked. I can pin the model variant and lock the config in the private control plane. Will also confirm KMS access for the tenant key.

miguel: +1. Propose rollback triggers: P95 latency >200ms OR 5xx rate >1% sustained for 10m. Also if prompt-quality regressions reported by QA > 3 fails in eval set.

sam.w:Agree on triggers. Add an automatic routing fallback to the compatible quantized variant (same arch) if GPU pool shows capacity pressure. Fallback command: `route set zephyr --variant v2.2-quant --priority fallback`

deploybot: [deploybot] Scheduled: `deploy window` created for tenant=zephyr start=2026-03-28T02:00Z duration=3h image=redwood/serve:v2.3.1-rc3 pinned=true policies=[canary:10,auto-rollout:true,rollback:standby]

releasebot: release notes (snippet) -> "v2.3.1-rc3: latency optimizations for KV cache, improved batching heuristics. Known issue: occasional tokenization divergence on long-form prompts (>4096). Monitoring enabled."

lucy: KMS check done — tenant key accessible from private control plane, no anomalies. I pinned the variant and put the runtime image on safety hold; only deploybot can start during the window.

miguel: Ops runbook update: I've added the rollback playbook steps and added a quick revert command: `deploybot rollback --tenant zephyr --image redwood/serve:v2.2.9 --reason "auto-trigger"` Also added metric dashboards and a runbook link.

oncall: oncall here — I'll be watching the dashboard and will trigger manual rollback if thresholds breach. Please alert in this thread at first sign of regression.

sam.w: Thanks everyone. I'll post a short pre-roll checklist 30m before start (routes, KMS, traffic slices, canary traces). If all acks remain, go/no-go will be thumbs-up in this thread at T-10m. :thumbsup:

releasebot: Note: after rollout completes, we'll tag the tenant config `zephyr@v2.3.1-rc3` and produce a formal changelog entry for the customer-facing release notes.

sam.w: All acked — standby/rollback pinned, metrics set, KMS validated. See you at roll time.

[END THREAD]
